crossRefs.note: “There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”
crossRefs.keyword: Destruction. Heb. Cutting off. and they

crossRefs.note: They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves…
crossRefs.keyword: Destruction. Heb. Cutting off. and they

crossRefs.note: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!
crossRefs.keyword: Destruction. Heb. Cutting off. and they

crossRefs.note: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan. The whole land trembles at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones…
crossRefs.keyword: Destruction. Heb. Cutting off. and they

crossRefs.note: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.
crossRefs.keyword: Destruction. Heb. Cutting off. and they

crossRefs.note: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets. Our end is near. Our days are fulfilled, for our end has come.
crossRefs.keyword: Destruction. Heb. Cutting off. and they

crossRefs.note: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from Yahweh to the gate of Jerusalem.

translations.web: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.
translations.bsb: Anguish is coming! They will seek peace, but find none.
translations.kjv: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace,
translations.asv: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.
